Method of Attack: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands ransom for file decryption
Employs double extortion tactic by threatening to release captured data unless ransom is paid
Deletes volume shadow copies to prevent recovery
Uses OpenSSL library to encrypt files to the AES standard
Attack Vector: Launched via command line after access to an environment is provided through another method
No single stated infection vector; depends on the individual victim
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note providing an ID and a unique Tor page for payment
